idea-plugin.name: Interface Resource-Close Divergence Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Flags a call through an interface-typed reference, passing a resource (JDBC or I/O stream), where SOME real implementations guarantee closing it on every path (CWE-772) while at least one other real implementation never does -- the interface type alone never guarantees which behavior you get once dependency injection swaps implementations.

The TRIPLE combination this catalog's Tier -3 batch is built around: real Class Hierarchy Analysis (Interface Exception Divergence Companion's own resolution of EVERY real implementation) applied over whole-project summaries that are THEMSELVES the product of a real Tarjan-SCC interprocedural fixed point (Log Injection Companion's own technique) computed via a branch-merging path-sensitive engine (JDBC Double-Close Companion's own technique) -- three previously-separate analysis techniques combined in one mechanism for the first time in this catalog.

Stated honestly: v0.1 only interfaces with 2-10 real implementations; same resource types and taint scope as its two base mechanisms. No dedicated Marketplace plugin found for this exact angle.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no network calls.

localInspection.displayName: Interface implementations diverge on guaranteeing resource close
